name: Oq Ko'cha

method.text: No frame is drawn. The picture is solved by marching a distance field at every pixel — renderer webgl2, GLSL ES 3.00, two-pass deferred.
8 shots, each written in whole frames: 72 · 53 · 36 · 31 · 34 · 19 · 39 · 66.
The film is 350 frames in total — 14.58 s at 24 fps; the soundtrack timeline is exactly as many frames.
The exposure sheet has 8 slots: 3·2·1·2·3·2·1·2, 12 drawings a second, 24 frames.
Characters and poses are in a JSON document and the GLSL is generated from it — 701 lines of source.

look: A snow-covered street. One building is folded with mod, and the cell index is hashed for height, width and setback; the lamps sit in their own cells. Thick air swallows the far end of the street; the near buildings are bounded with hard ink.

hardEdgeShare: share of hard edges — this film is drawn in ink
value.range: levels between the darkest and the brightest

texture: paper grain — thinned after the frequency bounding (4.02)
